A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TRACED research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices A–P. Appendix pages 12–25 are identical in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original evaluations across six benchmarks and four models in Table 1, plus ablations, robustness analyses, cognitive-state analyses, and qualitative cases.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and the appendices, including the benchmark comparisons in Table 1.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Section 3 retain the same semantic whitening, contrastive subspace construction, displacement and curvature features, and Gaussian Bayesian assessment procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8K, MATH, TheoremQA, GPQA, Social IQA, and Understanding Fables. Structured/open-ended coverage and the transfer, imbalance, and complexity scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains MSP, Perplexity, Entropy, LR Probe, SAPLMA, CoE, and CoT-Kinetics in the same comparisons. Figure 2 also preserves the same global-fit, task-specific, and transfer comparisons.

E3.justification: The four evaluated models, AUROC/AUPR/FPR@95 metrics, question-level 8:2 splitting, generation settings, and analysis protocols remain unchanged. No experiment or evaluation setting is added or revised.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same component ablations, dimension and reference-size sensitivity, imbalance and complexity robustness, transfer analyses, scaling analyses, and cognitive case studies. Their evidence is unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix N retains 95% confidence intervals estimated from 1,000 stratified bootstrap resamples and the same significance reporting in Table 9. Figure 5 retains standard-deviation shading; no run-count or uncertainty-reporting changes occur.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 reports the same TRACED GPQA AUROC of 0.8300 for DeepSeek-R1-Llama-8B in both versions.

T1.justification: The geometric definitions and equations remain unchanged. Appendix E preserves the same stochastic-flow assumptions, linear and square-root displacement scaling theorems, and proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometric separation of reasoning quality, competitive and robust assessment, and correspondence with hesitation and certainty.

C2.justification: The interpretations of hesitation loops, certainty accumulation, domain-dependent geometry, and centroid alignment are unchanged. Existing qualifications about extreme class imbalance and limited reference data are also retained.

D1.justification: The appendices preserve identical generation hyperparameters, token limits, prompts, parsing and judge procedures, baseline implementation details, and cognitive vocabularies. No technical disclosure or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 5, Appendix P, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. References reflow across pages without additions or removals.

P1.justification: The printed preprint date changes from March 12 to May 5, 2026, and the arXiv version/date line is updated. Scientific wording, terminology, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Main-text spacing and page/column breaks change: Equation 1 moves from page 3 to page 2, and the conclusion fits entirely on page 8 instead of continuing onto page 9. Figure content, captions, and table structures are preserved; appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v2.pdf updates dates and tightens pagination, keeping some passages together. Methods, theory, results, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the entire appendix. These limited formatting adjustments do not materially alter the paper's overall quality.
